summary.text: Lee Reeves is the Republican state representative for Tennessee House District 65, part of Williamson County, who took office in November 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He works in real estate and has a law degree from Georgetown University.

paragraphs.text: Reeves holds a B.A. from Emory University and a J.D. from Georgetown University Law Center, and the legislature's biography lists his occupation as real estate.
Ballotpedia describes his career experience as real estate law and investment.
He is a past president of the Franklin Lions Club and served as a commissioner on the Franklin Board of Zoning Appeals in 2023 and 2024.
Reeves has been a member of the House since the 114th General Assembly and serves on the Education Committee and the Finance, Ways, and Means Committee.
Ballotpedia reports that he faces Democrat Julian Pierre-Griffin in the general election.
